routes.title: 每日领取
lines: 每天登录领7张卡。完成契约战略对应腐蚀档位任务，45–80档合计可领600绑钻。

routes.title: 推荐 · 第5关
lines: 参考历史记录：全周登录＋约5,000钻石。
先用免费卡推进，最后一天只补实际缺口。

lines: 看库存，推荐做到300或600分档。

awakeRows.title: 星海旋律
lines: 每用1张卡＋3分；每次觉醒＋7分。
基础分上限1,500，与觉醒品质积分不同。

zh.awakeNote: 双倍通关奖励不包括宝库币。

paidRows.title: 两个超值礼包

paidNote: 需搭配钻石及绑钻购卡。

en.title: CARD CLASH WEEK
en.subtitle: Card Clash of Illusion × Soul Awakening
en.lead: Use free cards first. Top up on the final day.
en.leadNote: Historical estimates; actual costs depend on card luck and play.

routes.title: DAILY REWARDS
lines: Log in for 7 cards daily.
Complete Contractual Strategy tiers from Void Corruption 45–80 for 600 CSG in total.

routes.title: RECOMMENDED · STAGE 5
lines: Historical records: all daily cards + about 5,000 gems.
Use free cards first; cover only the remaining gap on the final day.

routes.title: OPTIONAL · STAGE 7
lines: Historical records: all daily cards + 6,000 gems + about 300–350 CSG.
Only consider if the gap is small and you need the reward.

en.exchange: Shop 1: first 4 purchases at half price. Each 5 Coins buys 1.25M Stellar; choose Crystals of Transcendence if needed.

awakeRows.title: Soul-Awakening Gala · 600 pts
lines: Choose the 300 or 600 point tier based on your stock.
Gala points depend on awakening quality.

awakeRows.title: Starlight Melody
lines: Each card used: +3 pts. Each awakening: +7 pts.
Base cap: 1,500. Separate from Gala quality points.

en.awakeNote: Double stage rewards exclude Treasury Coins.
en.prerequisite: Both routes: cards + awakenings must reach 1,500 base points.

paidRows.title: One Value Pack
paidRows.note: PLAY MANUALLY — DO NOT USE SWEEP.

paidRows.title: Two Value Packs
paidRows.note: Low risk; a small chance of needing extra cards.

paidNote: Also buy cards with gems and CSG.
Buy CSG Value Packs as needed; you likely won't need all of them.
